segments.name: Electric utility
segments.description: Integrated regulated electric utility serving residential, commercial, industrial and wholesale customers in Kansas and Missouri.
segments.evidence: The Evergy Companies assess financial performance and allocate resources on a consolidated basis (i.e., operate in one segment).

revenueModel.text: Evergy earns regulated retail electricity revenues from customers in Kansas and Missouri, plus wholesale and transmission revenues, with rates set by state and federal regulators.
revenueModel.evidence: Evergy serves approximately 1.7 million customers located in Kansas and Missouri.
